title: Docker container states and exit evidence
summary: Interpret container lifecycle state, exit evidence and health without equating “running” with application health.

concepts.title: Lifecycle state
concepts.explanation: Created, running, paused, restarting, exited and dead describe Docker lifecycle state.

concepts.title: Exit evidence
concepts.explanation: Exit code, error, timestamps and OOMKilled state help narrow termination behavior.

concepts.title: Health evidence
concepts.explanation: A configured health check adds application-oriented evidence but remains limited to its command and timing.

limitations: Running does not prove the workload is serving correct responses.
Full inspect output can expose environment values and internal configuration.
